description: Sets the pan position of a track's channel strips, -1 (hard left) to 1 (hard right), 0 centred - the pan slider of the channel view. Every strip of the track by default, one with channel. A mono stem has one strip; a stereo import's two strips start at -1 and 1. Playback and export_audio both follow it; get_project_info shows the current pans per track.

project.description: Path to the .audium project package (absolute paths recommended)

task.description: Name of the task this edit is part of, e.g. "remove speech pauses". In the open app, all edits with the same task name become one undo step: keep the name for every call of the task and change it when the next task starts. Without a task name, all edits of this session share one step

name: track_pan
title: Pan a track
